# GM notes

`f1`: on SSD storage a `random_page_cost` near 1.1 lets the planner prefer
index scans; 4.0 is the spinning-disk default. The fixture exists for
chunk 17b's loader checks of the data register (spec D434): it is loaded,
never deployed, so `f1` is never planted or checked. The record is
`vet-core`'s, the wards `vet-housing`'s, the agenda `vet-scheduling`'s, the
laboratory `vet-lab`'s, the machines' systems `vet-machinery`'s and the
owners' portal `vet-portal`'s; their notes are each domain's `docs/gm.md`.
Every producer is left out (`composition.yaml`). The true register is
`gm/data-register.yaml`, the handout `player/data-register.md`, both
generated by the data-register skill; no register fault is planted. The
owners' traffic is no third party: it has no `partners.md` entry.
